problem: Loopbreaker's delivery state is only reachable from the machine running it — an operator or the agent herd can't glance at shape, planning, review, and shipping without shelling into the repo. Rordi's rich SPA won't exist here; the herd needs a first-class way to see loopbreaker's own live visualizer.
appetite: One bounded slice: a Herdr plugin manifest plus a systemd-supervised launcher reusing the existing web/ visualizer, no Herdr-core changes.
smallest_slice: A herdr-plugin.toml whose start action supervises `loopbreaker serve` against one configured database, surfaced to the herd over Tailscale, modeled on the Collie launcher.
non_goals: Building a delivery view inside the Collie PWA
Any change to Herdr core or the Collie repo
success_signal: `herdr plugin link` registers herdr.loopbreaker, its start action brings up the visualizer as a durable service reachable over the tailnet, and the substrate pane renders the active issue inside Herdr.
reversibility: The uninstall action stops and disables the service and removes the systemd unit; the checkout and .env remain, and Herdr returns to exactly its prior state.

risks.risk: A host-global service maps poorly onto loopbreaker's per-repo databases.
risks.mitigation: Serve one explicit LOOPBREAKER_DB now; track multi-DB as a follow-up that LB-23 pressures.
